claim: A refunded order cannot be refunded again; the second refund request must return 400.
Refunds are only allowed for delivered orders; attempting to refund a placed order must return 400.
Refunds are only allowed for delivered orders; attempting to refund a cancelled order must return 400.
The 14-day refund window is counted from delivered_at; a request more than 14 days after delivered_at must return 400 even if created_at is recent.
A successful refund sets the order status to 'refunded' and records the refunded amount.
